Gen II Fund Services is seeking a Junior Full Stack Developer to support the expansion of its digital platforms. The role develops and maintains web applications, collaborates with engineering and cross-functional teams, and contributes across the development lifecycle, including database work, troubleshooting, and deployment.
Finance

Financial Services

No H1B
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain full-stack web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (React) and backend technologies (Java/Spring Boot or Node.js/Express)
Collaborate with senior developers and cross-functional teams to design, implement, and deploy features that meet business requirements
Write clean, maintainable code and participate in code reviews to ensure quality and best practices across the team
Troubleshoot and debug applications, identifying and resolving issues with attention to detail and problem-solving skills
Work with SQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) to design schemas, write queries, and optimize database performance
Participate in version control workflows using Git and contribute to CI/CD pipelines following Agile/Scrum methodologies
Take ownership of assigned tasks and see them through from development to production with minimal supervision
Continuously learn and stay updated with emerging technologies and industry best practices in full-stack development

Strong understanding of SQL and experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL (required)
Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and strong communication abilities (required)
Solid foundation in Git version control and understanding of CICD concepts (required)
